title: Hinomori Shiho — Concealed Joy〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: This Way! That Way! Zookeeper Day

rows.Line: Odaiba Animal Land
Chipmunk Habitat

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Now that we've finished feeding our shoebill, we'll feed the chipmunks next.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: That being said, there isn't much to it. All you really have to do is fill up the feeders that are set up around their habitat.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And that will provide enough food for all the chipmunks?

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Excellent question! If a chipmunk isn't feeling well, or the other chipmunks are pushing them off a feeder, then they may not be able to eat.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Which is why you'll need to scan the area to see if any haven't had any food.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Look for the hungry ones. Got it.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Exactly. You should feed the ones who have been pushed off by hand.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Understood.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um, what if we find any that don't seem to be feeling well, Mr. Nakazawa? Should we report them to you?

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line:
Yes, please do.
You're both really starting to get the hang of things.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Anyway, let's go give our little chipmunks a delicious meal.

rows.Speaker: Shiho & Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But I'm really worried.
What if the same that happened with Schubert happens with the chipmunks...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're taking it way too hard.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Don't worry. The chipmunks are very used to being around people.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line:
So, let's begin.
They should gather once you start refilling the feeders.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay.
Then, Minori, can you take that end?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Let's see...
We have to take out the leftovers before refilling it...

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Once you've refilled the larger feeders, please move on to the smaller ones.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa, the chipmunks are all gathering around the big feeders...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait, some are coming towards me...!
They're climbing up my arms!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: They must be really hungry.

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Now, start looking for any that are having trouble getting food.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
No, wait. Don't eat those.
There's plenty of food over here.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh... I don't think this one's had anything yet. Hey, here you are.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hehe. Do you like it?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, Shiho, look!
They're literally eating out of my hands!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wow, they are...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: H-How did you get them to do that?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: All I did was stretch out my hands to offer them some food!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh... That one's climbing up your arm...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
This is amazing, Shiho!
I wish you could feel this...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: F-Feel what?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I can feel the ones on my hands vibrating while they nibble on the food...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm gonna look for one too...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Are there any that still haven't eaten...?

rows.Speaker: Nakazawa
rows.Line: Ah, I think that one there was late to come out of the nesting box.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, you're right...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, I'll do what Minori did. Just offer it some food by stretching my hands out...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, it hopped onto your hands!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's really...eating from my hands...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. That's so cute!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: *Quiver*

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I wish I could stay here forever...
